envelope.description: Shell: attach button, chips and paste

body.title: Shell: attach button, chips and paste
body.summary: renderShell in chat-panel.ts, only when the seams are present: the icon-only `#insrc-attach` button as the first item of `.statusbar` posting pick-attachments; the chip row `#insrc-attachments` between `.inputbar` and `.statusbar`, hidden while empty, built with textContent, each chip with a remove control and, for a just-pasted image, a thumbnail from the data: URL the webview holds, matched by clientId; the error line; a paste on `#insrc-input` with image items posts attach-image per image and is prevented while a text paste is untouched; doSubmit also submits when the box is blank and chips are shown; the registry's onAttachmentOpen wired to post open-attachment. The content security policy is unchanged. Drag-and-drop and image previews in the transcript are out of scope, as recorded.
acceptanceChecks: The attach button posts pick-attachments and has no text, only an icon with an aria-label and title
An image paste posts attach-image with its base64 and mime and is prevented; a text paste is untouched
Chips render from attachments-pending with a remove control that posts remove-attachment; the error sentence is shown; an empty list hides the row
A blank box with chips submits; a blank box with none does not
The shell is still one nonce'd inline script under the same policy, with no innerHTML outside the guarded markdown path; without the seams it has no attach button or chip row

tests.name: shell script: the attach button posts pick-attachments, an image paste posts attach-image with its base64 and is prevented, a text paste is untouched, chips render from attachments-pending with a remove control, and a blank box with chips submits
shell: the attach button is icon-only with an aria-label, sits first in the status bar, and the content security policy is unchanged
shell script: a chip click on a sent message posts open-attachment, and the error sentence is shown and cleared
